title: CCD_FPS property is never released by indigo_ccd_detach
description:
indigo_ccd_attach() creates CCD_FPS_PROPERTY (indigo_libs/indigo_ccd_driver.c:242) but indigo_ccd_detach() never releases it; it is the only CCD base-class property without a release. Every CCD device of every driver loses 3656 bytes per attach/detach: at driver unload and on every unplug of a hot-plug camera. Valgrind: 5 blocks, 18280 bytes, one per simulator CCD device. Next: release CCD_FPS_PROPERTY in indigo_ccd_detach().
